Casablanca · Moroccan fine dining

A grand house for Moroccan cuisine

In Casablanca, Dar el Bacha serves Moroccan gastronomy with the care of a fine dining table: traditional recipes, carefully chosen produce, attentive service.

Book a tableExplore the menu

The house

An address in Casablanca

Dar el Bacha brings together Morocco's culinary heritage and the precision of fine dining. Every visit is meant as an invitation: take your seat, let us look after you, and taste.

Read our story

Philosophy

Tradition as a starting point

Moroccan recipes are passed down through gesture and patience. We serve them with the same respect, in a contemporary presentation that lets the produce speak.

The art of hospitality

The time of a meal

From your arrival to the end of the meal, every moment follows the rhythm of Moroccan hospitality: attentive, generous, never rushed.

The menu

Flavours of the menu

A deliberately concise menu, built around the great classics of Moroccan cuisine.

Explore the menu
  • 01 Starters Moroccan salads and seasonal starters
  • 02 Main courses Tagines, Fassi specialities and couscous
  • 03 Desserts Pastries, almonds and orange blossom
  • 04 Drinks Moroccan tea, infusions and fresh juices

Selection

Signature dishes

Lamb tagine with prunes and almonds

Slow-cooked lamb shoulder, caramelised prunes, toasted almonds and sesame seeds.

Chicken tagine with preserved lemon and olives

Chicken simmered with ginger and saffron, preserved lemon and violet olives.

Seven-vegetable couscous

Steamed fine semolina, fragrant broth, seven seasonal vegetables and lamb.

Lamb mechoui

Slow-roasted lamb shoulder, meltingly tender, served with cumin and salt.
